## v0.5.24: Complete entity counts and related memories on demand / 完整的实体计数与按需查找的相关记忆

Publishes [#332](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/332). The Entities page counts and lists every memory that carries an entity: the count is the number of those memories, the list holds every entity, and selecting one lists exactly those memories at once. Below them, **Find related memories** runs recall for the entity only when asked for, and stays open for the next entities until hidden. A Provider whose `list()` stops short of a space can supply the optional `entityIndex`.

发布 [#332](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/332)。实体页统计并列出带有某个实体的全部记忆：计数就是这些记忆的条数，列表包含全部实体，选中后立即正好列出这些记忆。其下的**查找相关记忆**只在需要时运行召回，展开后切换到其他实体时保持展开，直到收起。`list()` 取不全整个空间的 Provider 可以提供可选的 `entityIndex`。

The Starter advances to **0.5.24** and Memory Spaces to **0.5.16**. The other 16 component versions are unchanged.

Starter 升至 **0.5.24**，Memory Spaces 升至 **0.5.16**；其余 16 个组件版本不变。

On synthetic Native spaces, an entity counted 22 now lists 22 instead of 20 that included 3 without it, and the first memory shows 91–99 ms after a click instead of 400–1,891 ms. With 4 × 500 memories, a selection shows every carrying memory after 7–10 ms instead of 20 results after 1.5–1.7 s.

在合成的 Native 空间上，计数 22 的实体现在列出 22 条，而不是混有 3 条不带该实体的 20 条；点击后第一条记忆在 91–99 毫秒出现，原先为 400–1,891 毫秒。在 4 × 500 条记忆上，选中实体 7–10 毫秒后显示带有它的全部记忆，原先 1.5–1.7 秒后才显示 20 条结果。

From v0.5.22, use **Memory System → Status → Check versions → Update**, then restart DSH. Or install the exact version:

从 v0.5.22 可使用**记忆系统 → 状态 → 检查版本 → 更新**，然后重启 DSH；也可安装精确版本：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mnemon@0.5.24
```

No memory migration is required. 无需迁移已有记忆。
